sourceChecks.text: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の系譜・叙述で個人名を確認。集団名と区別する。

wikipediaArticleRead.title: Kehath
wikipediaArticleRead.outcomeJa: 独立検索後にWikipedia実記事を読み、KehathがKohathの異綴りでレビの子本人を扱うことを確認。対象節の父子関係と合うが、後代記述をプロフィールへ移さない。
wikipediaArticleRead.articleTextEvidenceJa: Lead identifies Kehath/Kohath as Levi’s son and patriarchal founder of the Kehathites; genealogy section names Amram. Profile note limits the link to the named person and does not import later genealogy.
wikipediaArticleRead.sourceGateJa: 記事名・リンクはプロフィールの初出より早く表示せず、wikipedia.knownByとsecondary-reference source.knownByを同じ節に設定。
